name: Lockspire – Limit Login And Smart Access Protection
author: ghimireanil

sections.description:
Lockspire – Limit Login And Smart Access Protection helps protect your WordPress site by limiting login attempts and blocking suspicious users. It makes your website safer and prevents unauthorized access easily.

Key Features:

  • 🛡️ Advanced Protection: Configurable login attempt limits with customizable lockout durations
  • 📊 Real-time Dashboard: Beautiful dashboard with live statistics and security monitoring
  • 🔒 IP Management: Whitelist and blacklist IP addresses for granular control
  • 🌍 Country Blocking: Block login attempts from specific countries
  • 📧 Smart Notifications: Email alerts for security events with customizable thresholds
  • 📋 Comprehensive Logging: Detailed activity logs with export functionality
  • 🎨 Modern Interface: Beautiful, responsive admin interface with tabbed navigation
  • ⚡ Performance Optimized: Smart caching for optimal database performance
  • 🔧 Developer Friendly: Clean, well-documented code following WordPress standards

Additional Information

Plugin URI: https://github.com/anilatgithub/login-attempt-limiter
Author URI: https://github.com/anilatgithub
Text Domain: lockspire

Security Features:
– CSRF protection with WordPress nonces
– Input sanitization and validation
– SQL injection prevention
– XSS protection
– Secure file handling

Performance Features:
– Smart caching system
– Optimized database queries
– Minimal resource usage
– Efficient log management

Compatibility:
– WordPress 5.0+
– PHP 7.4+
– Multisite compatible
– WooCommerce compatible
– Compatible with most caching plugins

Support:
For support and feature requests, please visit the GitHub repository or contact the developer.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the login-attempt-limiter folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Secure Guard in your WordPress admin to configure settings
  4. Adjust security settings according to your needs
sections.faq:
How does the plugin protect against brute-force attacks?

The plugin limits the number of failed login attempts from a single IP address within a specified time period. When the limit is exceeded, the IP is temporarily locked out.

Can I whitelist trusted IP addresses?

Yes! You can whitelist IP addresses in the Security tab. Whitelisted IPs will never be locked out, regardless of failed attempts.

Does the plugin work with multisite installations?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WordPress multisite installations and can be activated network-wide.

How do I receive security notifications?

Enable email notifications in the Notifications tab. You can configure custom email addresses and notification thresholds to avoid alert fatigue.

Can I export login logs?

Yes! The plugin allows you to export login activity logs in CSV format for analysis and record-keeping.
